summary: Portal Help Topics feature testing complete. All new KB-derived help topics endpoints and UI components are working correctly. 12 backend tests passed, 24 frontend tests passed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Portal Help Topics feature fully tested. New endpoints: GET /api/portal/help-topics (returns KB nav groups as topics with article_count, icon, description, sections, first_slug), GET /api/portal/help-topics/{topic_key} (returns single topic details), 404 for nonexistent topics. Frontend: PortalHome.js shows 'Browse our documentation' section with KB topic cards, PortalHelpTopic.js displays topic with sections and article links to /docs/{slug}, PortalCategory.js shows 'Related Documentation' from mapped KB groups. All existing portal categories still work. Test data testids: docs-topic-card-{key}, help-topic-page, help-section-{key}, help-article-{slug}, related-articles-section, related-article-{slug}.
